title: yencoding: multi-part CRC fallback uses whole-file crc32 against part data
description: decode.rs:144: pcrc32.or(crc32) for multi-part articles uses the whole-file crc32 when pcrc32 is absent, causing spurious CrcMismatch on valid articles from encoders that omit pcrc32. Fix: only use pcrc32 for multi-part articles.
